strongest_angle: Marking the centennial of Harry Houdini's death, The Strand Magazine and new centennial publications spotlight rediscovered writings by the famous illusionist alongside ongoing debates over his passing at Detroit's Grace Hospital.

key_facts.fact: The Strand Magazine is publishing a rediscovered work written by Harry Houdini to mark 100 years since his death.

A rare essay by the iconic escape artist Harry Houdini about magicians of the past has been published for the first time alongside a recent book revisiting questions about his death at Detroit’s Grace Hospital.
Auction house Potter & Potter offered a giant lobby portrait of Harry Houdini with an estimate of $5,000 to $10,000.
The Harry Ransom Center is holding an exhibition commemorating the famed illusionist Harry Houdini on the centenary of his death.
